wikipedia.pt: Cheias de 1967 na região de Lisboa

title: 1967 Portugal floods
summary: Wikidata item Q48876710, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "catastrophic flooding event that occurred in November 1967, affecting the Lisbon metropolitan area and surrounding regions". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
